terms.grammar: verb, third conjugation, with the dative of what is signed
evidence: M-O s.v. sign vb.: subscrībere (alicui reī); testāmentō subscrībere (Dig. 40.7.40)
terms.comment: Classically to write underneath: a caption under a statue (Cic. Clu. 101), one’s name under an accusation or a will (Lewis & Short).

evidence: Comen. OP 98: Epistula complicātur, īnscrībitur, et obsignātur.
terms.comment: Romans sealed a document with a ring rather than signing it.

sources: Lewis & Short: subscribo · Lewis & Short: subscriptio · Lewis & Short: obsigno
